info.title: WURK x402 Solana Social Growth Endpoints
info.description: Category-specific x402 listing surface for WURK Solana social growth endpoints: social engagement, followers, members, comments, reposts, bookmarks, and raid jobs. Public v2 flow uses `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`.

post.description:
Public x402 endpoint: `/solana/xlikes`.

Flow kind: **paid** endpoint.

Flow: call once **without** `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` to receive `402 Payment-Required`; sign the requirement; retry the same URL **with** `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` for `200`.

Use `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` for public routes (`/solana/*`, `/base/*`). `X-PAYMENT` is legacy/test context.

Pricing hint: `{"currency":"USDC","perUnit":0.025,"unit":"like"}`.

Defaults: `{"amount":40}`.

Limits: `{"amountMin":5,"amountMax":250}`.

PaymentSignature.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
PaymentSignature.description: x402 v2 payment signature for public routes. Omit on first request to get `402 Payment-Required`; include on retry to settle.

Requirement.name: requirement
Requirement.description: Optional single requirement selector for `agenttohumanadvanced`. Meaning: tweetScoutScore:* = Sorsa (formerly TweetScout) third-party X profile score; xMetricScore:* = WURK-generated X profile score (follower count, follower quality, profile signals); seekerUser = users in the Solana Seeker phone ecosystem; xBlueVerified = X account with a blue verified badge. Stricter requirements can reduce eligible participants and slow fill speed. Policy: tweetScoutScore:0 => max winners 100 + min perUser 0.05; tweetScoutScore:10 => max 75 + min 0.075; tweetScoutScore:25 => max 50 + min 0.125; xMetricScore:75 => max 100 + min 0.0625; xMetricScore:250 => max 50 + min 0.125; xBlueVerified => max 50 + min 0.075; seekerUser => baseline only.

WinnersPath.name: winners
WinnersPath.description: Winner/slot count in path alias. Range is endpoint-specific (commonly 1..100 for agent-help, 5..250 for social jobs).

resource.description: Requested resource metadata echoed by payment middleware.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Retry-after hint in seconds for rate-limited requests.

message.example: Thank you for your message. As soon as a human support team member is online, we will review your issue.

secret.description: Advanced job secret for creator-mode winner selection.

submissionIds.description: Winner submission ids as array or comma-separated string.

PaymentRequired.description: Payment required. Sign and retry with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` (public v2 flow).

PaidSuccess.description: Operation accepted/completed (after settlement on paid routes, or immediately for free variants).

BadRequest.description: Invalid request input or malformed payment signature.

NotFound.description: Requested resource, job, or secret could not be found.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded for wallet-threaded support chat.

Conflict.description: Conflict with current state (for example, duplicate/similar running job).
